prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If close to object, take it and check its properties. Move to destination. If not found, scan. list of available nodes: <Action ID = TakeObject     /> <Action ID = MoveToDestination     /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible     /> <Action ID = ApproachObject     /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject     /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached     /> <SubTree ID = ObjectProperties     />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
		DO ObjectProperties
		DO MoveToDestination
	END
